verdict.rationale: No evidence pack items describe diagnostic messages, logs, or warnings explaining why GPU acceleration failed or fell back to CPU; evidence only covers general GPU/CPU hybrid support and performance anecdotes, some of which mention unexpected slowness (e.g., llama-cpp-comm-9, comm-10) without any diagnostic explanation surfaced. missing for 10: explicit fallback/error diagnostics, logging of GPU detection failures, documentation of verbose/debug flags explaining backend selection.
